description: Ministry of Labour - Order to apply the Provisions to the Trade of Rubber Cultivation and Raw Rubber Processing
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory instrument issued under the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136). It applies the provisions of Part II of the Ordinance to the Rubber Cultivation and Raw Rubber Processing Trade, which constitutes the creation of new regulatory requirements. The content focuses on establishing legal frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
